agyos_skill.intent: Linux system troubleshooting workflow for diagnosing and resolving system issues, performance problems, and service failures.
agyos_skill.instructions: Specialized workflow for diagnosing and resolving Linux system issues including performance problems, service failures, network issues, and resource constraints. Use this workflow when: - Diagnosing system performance issues - Troubleshooting service failures - Investigating network problems - Resolving disk space issues - Debugging application errors - `bash-linux` - Linux commands - `devops-troubleshooter` - Troubleshooting 1. Check system uptime 2. Review recent changes 3. Identify symptoms 4. Gather error messages 5. Document findings ```bash uptime hostnamectl cat /etc/os-release dmesg | tail -50 ``` ``` Use @bash-linux to gather system information ``` - `bash-linux` - Resource commands - `performance-engineer` - Performance analysis
